battle.name: 俄國革命
battle.brief: 1917年3月，俄國革命首先在彼得格勒爆發，帝國軍隊、臨時政府與革命武裝在城市及各地形成公開衝突。戰事包含街壘、砲擊與兵變；1865年正式列裝的施拿甫步槍（Sharps rifle）曾屬美軍制式步槍，以單發後膛機構提供遠程精射，並用於步兵與守備單位。

kit.name: 施拿甫步槍
kit.history: 施拿甫步槍是美軍制式步槍系列的一員，採單發後膛結構，主要配備於步兵單位，負責遠距精確射擊與要點守備，並曾供西部邊防單位使用。

countries: 1917年2月至10月，戰事主體發生在俄國本土，參與者不只分成固定敵我兩方。俄國境內同時存在羅曼諾夫王朝、臨時政府、各級蘇維埃、軍事委員會與反對十月奪權的軍官團體。主要地理戰場包括彼得格勒與波羅的海沿岸、喀爾巴阡山南北側的加利西亞戰線、立陶宛與白俄羅斯附近的西線、北高加索與外高加索、土耳其斯坦方面，以及北極圈內的穆爾曼斯克與阿爾漢格爾斯克。境外則有德意志帝國、奧匈帝國、鄂圖曼帝國與保加利亞同俄軍交戰，羅馬尼亞軍隊在1917年夏季參與加利西亞攻勢；英軍、法軍代表及加拿大第259營在北方援助俄方。因此，這不是只發生在宮殿門前的事件，而是一場把彼得格勒軍政中樞、東線正面和北方海路連在一起的革命戰役。
countriesEn: From February to October 1917, the main theater of operations lay inside Russia, and the participants did not divide into fixed opposing camps. Within the country, the Romanov dynasty, the Provisional Government, soviets at several levels, military committees, and officer groups opposing the October seizure of power all operated at the same time. The principal theaters included Petrograd and the Baltic coast, the Galician front on both sides of the Carpathians, the western front near Lithuania and White Russia, the North Caucasus and Transcaucasia, Turkestan, and the Arctic ports of Murmansk and Archangel. Outside Russia, the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria fought the Russian Army. Romanian forces joined the Galician offensive in the summer of 1917, while British troops, French military representatives, and Canadian Battalion 259 supported the Russian side in the north. This was therefore not an event confined to the gates of a palace. It was a revolutionary campaign connecting the military and political center in Petrograd, the main Eastern Front, and the northern sea routes.
people: 羅曼諾夫皇帝尼古拉二世在1917年2月仍兼任最高統帥，兵變擴大後退位；彼得格勒軍區司令彼得・斯特列爾尼科夫是二月軍隊崩解初期的重要指揮官。臨時政府的陸軍與海軍部長、後來兼任總理的亞歷山大・克倫斯基，必須在彼得格勒、莫爾曼斯克與各戰線之間維持命令鏈；外交部長巴維爾・米留可夫因1917年4月的對外政策聲明引發軍隊拒絕返回前線的「四月危機」。阿列克謝・布魯西洛夫主持同年6月的大規模進攻，拉夫・科爾尼洛夫以第三騎兵軍逼近彼得格勒，試圖以軍事壓力改變臨時政府。德方由興登堡與魯登道夫掌握戰略方向，奧匈總參謀長康拉德・馮・赫岑多夫主持東線反擊。九月成立的彼得格勒軍事革命委員會由列夫・托洛茨基主持，弗拉基米爾・波德沃伊斯基參與參謀安排，軍官出身的弗拉基米爾・安東諾夫－奧夫謝延科負責實際軍事部署；這些人與各團、連的士兵代表共同決定了十月奪權能否運作。
peopleEn: Emperor Nicholas II still combined the position of emperor with that of commander in chief when the February mutiny began, and he abdicated as it spread. Pyotr Strelnikov, commander of the Petrograd Military District, was a principal officer during the initial breakdown of military control. Alexander Kerensky, first Minister of War and Navy and later Prime Minister of the Provisional Government, had to maintain a chain of command between Petrograd, Murmansk, and the several fronts. Foreign Minister Pavel Milyukov's April 1917 declaration on foreign policy provoked the April Crisis, in which troops refused to return to the front. Alexei Brusilov directed the large offensive of June that year, while Lavr Kornilov advanced the Third Cavalry Army toward Petrograd in an attempt to change the Provisional Government through military pressure. Hindenburg and Ludendorff set German strategic direction, and Conrad von Hötzendorf directed the Austro-Hungarian counteroffensive on the Eastern Front. The Petrograd Military Revolutionary Committee, established in September, was chaired by Leon Trotsky. Vladimir Podvoisky participated in its staff planning, and Vladimir Antonov-Ovseenko, an officer by training, handled the practical military deployment. Together with soldier representatives from the regiments and companies, these figures determined whether the October seizure of power could function.
kits: 1917年俄軍步兵以三線栓動的莫辛－納甘特M1891步槍為主，軍官、炮組與下士官使用五發式納甘特M1891轉輪手槍，連級火力則依靠7.62毫米Maxim M1910重機槍；炮兵有76.2毫米M1902師屬砲與同口徑團屬砲。俄軍也繼續使用更早的Maxim M1895及M1905重機槍，不能把所有機槍型號一概視為1917年新裝。補給以馬匹、標準鐵路車廂、1916年列裝的AMO F-15一噸半卡車及福特T型底盤改裝車執行，裝甲車則與步兵、炮兵及工兵協同。德軍使用Gewehr 98步槍與MG08／15重機槍，奧匈軍使用Steyr M1895步槍及Schwarzlose M1897／12重機槍；英法軍裝備有Lebel M1886、Berthier M1907／15步槍、Vickers重機槍、18磅野戰砲及Schneider CA1 75毫米砲。戰線上已出現1915年服役的英國Mark IV坦克、1917年服役的法國Renault FT-17，航空兵可見SPAD VII與Sopwith1½ Strutter。海上的關鍵裝備是1903年服役的帕拉達級巡洋艦「奧羅拉號」與四艘Gangut級主力艦，它們分別承擔訊號、封鎖與火力支援，而不是一艘艦單獨決定革命。
kitsEn: Russian infantry relied principally on the three-line bolt-action Mosin-Nagant Model 1891 rifle in 1917. Officers, artillery crews, and noncommissioned officers used the five-shot Nagant Model 1891 revolver, while company firepower depended on the 7.62 mm Maxim Model 1910 machine gun. Russian artillery included the 76.2 mm Model 1902 divisional gun and regimental guns of the same caliber. The army also continued to employ the earlier Maxim Model 1895 and Model 1905 machine guns, so not every machine gun in service can be treated as a new 1917 issue. Supply trains depended on horses, standard railway wagons, the AMO F-15 one-and-a-half-ton truck introduced in 1916, and modified Ford Model T chassis. Armored cars operated in cooperation with infantry, artillery, and engineers. German forces used Gewehr 98 rifles and MG08/15 machine guns, while Austro-Hungarian troops carried Steyr Model 1895 rifles and Schwarzlose Model 1897/12 machine guns. British and French forces had Lebel Model 1886 and Berthier Model 1907/15 rifles, Vickers machine guns, 18-pounder field guns, and Schneider CA1 75 mm guns. By 1917 the front also contained the British Mark IV tank, in service since 1915, and the French Renault FT-17, introduced that year. Russian aviation used aircraft including the SPAD VII and Sopwith One-and-a-Half Strutter. The decisive naval equipment included the Pallada-class protected cruiser Aurora, commissioned in 1903, and four Gangut-class pre-dreadnoughts. They supplied signals, blockade duties, and fire support; no single vessel decided the revolution by itself.
tactics: 二月戰變首先是一場軍區內部的指揮崩解。彼得格勒守備後備營拒絕驅散示威的命令後，部隊從營房湧向市中心，士兵和軍官同時控制火車站、電報局、武器庫與重要路口，使臨時政府無法連續下達命令。三月第一號命令把士兵代表與士兵委員會制度寫入軍隊，舊式指揮關係由是可被罷免或越級發令。七月危機中，交戰各方先爭奪塔夫里達宮、涅瓦河渡口、兵營和通往彼得格勒的鐵路；政府的忠於政府部隊與軍校候補生一度靠裝甲車和集中火力的封鎖線把起義士兵壓回營區。科爾尼洛夫事件則顯示，奪取鐵路樞紐和讓前線部隊轉向，比占領一個車站更能決定政治成敗。十月軍事革命委員會採取分階段控制：第一階段奪取電報、電話、機車廠、武器庫與彼得堡和保羅要塞，並以巡洋艦「奧羅拉號」的空包彈作訊號；第二階段由波羅的海艦隊水兵、赤衛隊和革命部隊從多個方向逼近冬宮。守軍以軍官、候補生及少量步兵集中於冬宮與亞歷山大宮，通訊和補給一旦中斷便失去協同射擊能力，宮內部隊相繼投降。莫斯科軍委採同一節點控制法，基輔則出現數日雙方反覆爭奪。
tacticsEn: The February struggle began as a collapse of command inside the Petrograd Military District. After Petrograd's reserve garrison battalions refused an order to disperse a demonstration, troops moved from their barracks into the city center. Soldiers and officers simultaneously occupied railway stations, the telegraph office, arsenals, and important road junctions, preventing the Provisional Government from issuing a continuous series of orders. The First Order of March formally recognized soldier representatives and soldiers' committees within the army, making the old chain of command removable and open to instructions from below. During the July Days, both sides first fought for the Tauride Palace, crossings over the Neva, barracks, and the railway approaches to Petrograd. Government-loyal troops and military cadets briefly used armored cars and concentrated fire to push the insurgent soldiers back toward their barracks. The Kornilov affair demonstrated that seizing railway junctions and turning front-line units against the government mattered more for political survival than taking an isolated railway station. In October, the Military Revolutionary Committee used phased control. The first phase secured the telegraph, telephone, locomotive works, arsenals, and the Peter and Paul Fortress, with a blank round from the cruiser Aurora serving as a signal. Baltic Fleet sailors, Red Guards, and revolutionary troops then approached the Winter Palace along several axes. The defenders concentrated officers, cadets, and a small number of infantry at the Winter and Alexander Palaces. Once communications and supply were disrupted, coordinated fire became impossible and the palace units surrendered in succession. The Moscow military committee used the same method of controlling key nodes, while fighting in Kiev continued for several days as control changed hands repeatedly.
data: 關鍵日期以俄曆為首，新曆日期置於括號內。2月23日（3月8日），彼得格勒守備軍拒絕命令，兵變擴大；2月27日（3月12日），臨時政府成員被拘；3月1日（3月14日），彼得格勒蘇維埃發布第一號命令；3月2日（3月15日），尼古拉二世在普斯科夫退位。4月18日至5月5日（5月1日至18日），米留可夫的聲明與談話造成四月危機。7月18日至29日（7月31日至8月11日）發生七月危機；8月25日至31日（9月7日至13日），科爾尼洛夫部向彼得格勒推進但遭軍隊拒絕；9月12日（9月25日），軍事革命委員會正式成立。10月24日至25日（11月6日至7日），委員會奪取關鍵節點、冬宮與臨時政府文件。布魯西洛夫攻勢於6月23日（7月6日）發動，高峰作戰序列約有五十七個步兵師及炮兵約一千七百門；第七軍向利沃夫方向推進，第八軍指向伊萬諾－弗蘭科夫斯克，第十一軍向普熱梅希爾與喀爾巴阡山施壓。步兵仍按栓動步槍射擊，制式腰包雖以攜帶約一百二十發設計，野戰配給通常低於設計量；炮彈依口徑分發，部分炮位只配少量攻擊彈，使砲兵準備火力縮短。1917年全俄各線傷亡因檔案散失、統計口徑不同及政權更替而沒有可信的單一精確總數，因此本文不列總數。
dataEn: Key dates are given first in the Russian old calendar, with the new-calendar date in parentheses. On February 23, or March 8, Petrograd's garrison refused its orders and the mutiny spread. On February 27, or March 12, members of the Provisional Government were detained. On March 1, or March 14, the Petrograd Soviet issued the First Order. On March 2, or March 15, Nicholas II abdicated at Pskov. Milyukov's statements and interviews between April 18 and May 5, corresponding to May 1 through May 18, produced the April Crisis. The July Days ran from July 18 to July 29, or July 31 through August 11. Between August 25 and August 31, or September 7 through September 13, Kornilov's troops advanced toward Petrograf but were refused by other units. The Military Revolutionary Committee was formally established on September 12, or September 25. On October 24 and 25, or November 6 and 7, the committee seized the essential nodes, the Winter Palace, and government documents. The Brusilov Offensive began on June 23, or July 6. At its height, the order of battle included approximately fifty-seven infantry divisions and about 1,700 artillery pieces. The Seventh Army advanced toward Lvov, the Eighth toward Ivano-Frankivsk, and the Eleventh toward Przemysl and the Carpathians. Infantry still fired bolt-action rifles. Although standard cartridge pouches were designed to carry roughly 120 rounds, field issue was normally below the design allowance. Artillery ammunition was distributed according to caliber, and some positions received only a small number of rounds for attack missions, shortening artillery preparation. Records lost, differing accounting methods, and repeated changes of government make it impossible to give one reliable exact total of Russian casualties across all fronts in 1917, so no overall figure is stated.
cause: 革命的直接起點不是一個抽象口號，而是1916年至1917年戰爭負荷進入軍隊日常。前線傷員累積、補充營訓練不足、輪換緩慢，炮彈、馬匹、糧食與冬季裝備的分配失去平衡；許多團在連續作戰後仍被要求發動新攻勢，軍官卻無法保證補給和指揮連續。1917年2月，彼得格勒後備守備軍首先拒絕鎮壓命令，接著奪取通信與武器節點，軍隊內的日常抗命因此變成能改變首都政權的行動。尼古拉二世退位後，臨時政府與蘇維埃並存，軍隊委員會、士兵代表與政治組織都宣稱可以代表部隊，命令權於是分裂。4月的外交聲明與5月的談話使士兵認為政府仍要迫使他們返回前線，四月危機因而把外交爭執變成拒絕開戰。七月危機及科爾尼洛夫的推進，則暴露臨時政府對武裝力量控制薄弱；前線士兵不願替臨時政府向彼得格勒開火，使軍事反抗先在政府內部瓦解。九月以後，軍事革命委員會把軍區通信、物資與駐軍分布整理成可執行的奪權計畫，士兵委員會的既有網絡、水兵的武器和碼頭控制，便成為十月軍事行動的基礎。
causeEn: The immediate beginning of the revolution was not an abstract slogan. It was the pressure of the 1916 to 1917 war entering the daily life of the army. Casualties accumulated at the front, replacement units lacked training, rotations were slow, and the distribution of shells, horses, food, and winter equipment lost balance. Many units were still ordered to launch fresh attacks after prolonged fighting, while officers could no longer guarantee supply or continuity of command. In February 1917, Petrograd's reserve garrison first refused orders to suppress crowds, then occupied communications and weapons nodes. Ordinary military disobedience thus became an action capable of changing the government of the capital. After Nicholas II abdicated, the Provisional Government and the soviets existed side by side. Army committees, soldier representatives, and political organizations all claimed the right to speak for troops, and authority was divided accordingly. The April declaration and the May statements led soldiers to believe that the government still intended to force them back to the front. The April Crisis therefore turned a diplomatic dispute into refusal to fight. The July Days and Kornilov's advance exposed the Provisional Government's weak control over armed forces. Front-line soldiers would not fight for it against Petrograd, so the military challenge broke down inside the government before it could alter that government. After September, the Military Revolutionary Committee turned the military district's communications, supplies, and garrison positions into a workable seizure plan. Existing soldier-committee networks, sailors' weapons, and control of the docks became the foundation of the October operation.
impact: 第一號命令與各地士兵委員會最直接的影響，是指揮官即使保有軍銜，也未必能使團、連服從。軍令被越級轉發，舊參謀系統與政治代表互相牴觸，離開陣地、拒絕攻勢和集體請願在多條戰線擴散。前線並未因此立即停戰，1917年夏季仍能集結五十七個師發動攻勢，但補充與炮彈不足使布魯西洛夫只能取得加利西亞的大片地面成果，未能把局部突破延伸為戰略崩潰；9月奧匈軍在加利西亞反攻，重新奪回普熱梅希爾等地。德軍同月收復里加，顯示東線戰略主動權又回到中歐盟軍手中。外高加索方面，俄軍6月攻入埃里溫，但鄂圖曼軍在秋季反攻，至俄曆年末先後收復卡爾斯與薩拉卡梅什。北方戰線則因英軍、法軍代表與加拿大部隊進駐穆爾曼斯克和阿爾漢格爾斯克而改變，阿爾漢格爾斯克至穆爾曼斯克鐵路未完全貫通，補給需依靠港口、鐵路與冬季道路。由此可見，1917年的軍事結果不只取決於陣亡與負傷的數量，也取決於各部隊是否仍接受中央命令。
impactEn: The most immediate effect of the First Order and the soldiers' committees was that an officer might retain his rank without being able to make a regiment or company obey. Orders were transmitted outside the chain of command, the old staff system and political representatives issued conflicting instructions, and desertion, refusal of attacks, and collective petitions spread across several fronts. The fronts did not cease fighting immediately. The Russian Army could still mobilize fifty-seven divisions for the summer offensive of 1917, but inadequate replacements and artillery ammunition limited Brusilov to substantial ground gains in Galicia rather than a strategic collapse of the enemy. In September, the Austro-Hungarian army counterattacked in Galicia and recovered Przemysl and other positions. The Germans regained Riga in the same month, showing that strategic initiative on the Eastern Front had returned to the Central Powers. In Transcaucasia, Russian forces entered Erivan in June, but the Ottoman counteroffensive in the autumn recovered Kars and Sarikamish by the end of the Russian old-calendar year. The northern front changed when British troops, French military representatives, and Canadian units entered Murmansk and Archangel. Because the railway between Archangel and Murmansk was not fully connected, supply depended on ports, railways, and winter roads. The military result of 1917 therefore depended not only on the number of dead and wounded but also on whether individual units continued to obey central authority.
result: 到1917年12月，這場革命在軍事上留下三層結果。第一層在二月完成：王朝崩潰，尼古拉二世退位，臨時政府接管彼得格勒，但蘇維埃與士兵委員會仍掌握部分武裝單位。第二層發生在四月至八月：米留可夫事件削弱政府信用，七月政府軍鎮壓首都起義成功，科爾尼洛夫的部隊卻在接近彼得格勒時失去前線支持，軍事上無法迫使臨時政府改組，臨時政府的軍權也因自身軍隊分裂而更弱。第三層在十月完成：軍事革命委員會先控制首都通信與交通，再攻入冬宮，拘押臨時政府成員；莫斯科軍委隨後掌握主要陣地，基輔等城市的武裝衝突延續數日，政治控制並未在同一天整齊落定。各軍區的效忠並未同時整齊完成，舊俄軍仍帶著編制分歧、補給不足和委員會命令並行。全俄作戰中心因此轉向蘇維埃，但這不是一場把全國軍隊瞬間整編完成的會戰。直接延伸的軍事結果是俄軍失去繼續東線作戰的能力：俄方與德意志帝國、奧匈帝國、鄂圖曼帝國及保加利亞在12月22日（1918年1月4日）達成停戰，1918年1月3日（1月16日）再簽訂和約。十月奪權鞏固了彼得格勒的政權，卻同時迫使新政府面對一支尚未整編、且已與敵軍停戰的龐大軍隊；此後的衝突轉入俄國內部的軍事內戰階段。
resultEn: By December 1917, the revolution had produced three distinct military results. The first was completed in February: the dynasty collapsed, Nicholas II abdicated, and the Provisional Government took charge of Petrograd, although soviets and soldiers' committees still controlled some armed units. The second developed from April through August. The Milyukov affair damaged the government's credibility. Government troops successfully suppressed the rising in the capital during the July Days, but Kornilov's troops lost front-line support as they approached Petrograd and could not force a reorganization of the Provisional Government. The government's military authority weakened further because its own forces were divided. The third was completed in October. The Military Revolutionary Committee first took control of the capital's communications and transport, then entered the Winter Palace and detained the Provisional Government's members. The Moscow military committee subsequently secured the principal positions, while armed conflicts in cities such as Kiev continued for several days and political control did not settle everywhere on the same day. Loyalty did not become uniform across the military districts at one moment. The old Russian Army continued to suffer conflicting formations, inadequate supply, and parallel orders from committees. The operational center of power therefore shifted toward the soviets, but this was not a single battle that instantly reorganized the national army. The direct military consequence was Russia's inability to continue the war on the Eastern Front. Russia and the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria concluded an armistice on December 22, or January 4, 1918, and signed a peace treaty on January 3, or January 16. The October seizure consolidated power in Petrograd, but it also forced the new government to confront an enormous army that had not been reorganized and had already accepted an enemy armistice. The conflict then entered a military civil-war phase within Russia.
